column1: # Ground Truth Dataset: SECIL Business KPIs (2020-2024)
# Source: Based on Performance Review data structure + realistic cement industry patterns
# Purpose: Forecasting validation for non-seasonal business variables
# - revenue_eur_m: Monthly revenue in EUR millions (seasonal with demand)
# - sales_volume_kt: Sales volume in thousands of tonnes (seasonal)
# - variable_margin_eur_ton: Unit variable margin (affected by energy costs)
# - thermal_cost_eur_ton: Thermal energy cost per ton (fuel price driven)
# - EURIBOR correlation with financing costs (indirect EBITDA impact)
